resume.headline: Customer Support Specialist
resume.summary: Customer Support professional with 6 years across SaaS and consumer products. Handles Tier 1-2 troubleshooting, escalation management, and knowledge base ownership across email, chat, and phone.

experience.title: Customer Support Specialist
bullets: Resolved customer inquiries across email, live chat, and phone via Zendesk, consistently meeting first-response and resolution SLA targets
Diagnosed and triaged technical issues, reproducing bugs and submitting structured reports to Engineering with logs and repro steps
Investigated API errors using Postman and browser DevTools to identify root cause before escalation
Authored and maintained knowledge base articles in Confluence, reducing repeat ticket volume on top issues
Built Zendesk macros and triggers to streamline refunds, password resets, and account changes
Onboarded and mentored new hires using documented playbooks and shadowing

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Owned Tier-1 support queue handling email and chat tickets across a high-volume consumer base
Resolved account access, billing, and order issues with an empathetic, clear written tone
Coordinated with the fulfillment team on escalations and tracked recurring issues for Product
Used Intercom for inbound chat and HubSpot Service Hub for case management
Consistently exceeded team CSAT and SLA targets

certifications: HubSpot Service Hub Certification - HubSpot Academy, 2024
